description: Author a comprehensive audit report at ISSUES_REPORT.md in the repo root. This is the user's primary requested deliverable: an end-to-end analysis of the web portal listing every issue found, categorized by severity level (Critical / High / Medium / Low), each tagged with an error type/class (Security, Runtime error, Type/Logic error, Accessibility, UX, Performance, Config/Build, Dependency), plus a section of improvement ideas to make the website better. The report must be grounded in the actual findings enumerated in the steps below (real file paths and line references). This feature is documentation only; the actual code fixes are applied in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. The report should note, per issue, whether it is auto-fixed in FEAT-002/003 or left as a recommendation.
steps: Create ISSUES_REPORT.md in the repository root with a title and a short 'How this was analyzed' intro (React 18 + Vite SPA frontend, Express 4 API backend; baseline `npm run lint` and `npm run build` both PASS, so issues are logic/security/a11y/UX rather than compile errors).
Add a Severity legend (Critical / High / Medium / Low) and an Error-type legend (Security, Runtime, Type/Logic, Accessibility, UX, Performance, Config/Build, Dependency).

Document CRITICAL/HIGH issues with file:line references: (1) server/agents.ts:99 default Gemini model is 'gemini-3.6-flash' which is not a valid model id (every other module uses 'gemini-2.0-flash') so the main AI chat fails unless GEMINI_MODEL is set [Runtime/Config, HIGH]; (2) server/auth.ts:756, server/auth.ts:1049, server/auth.ts:1557 and server/sms-otp.ts:13 use Math.random() to generate security-sensitive OTP codes and the AI PIN, which is not cryptographically secure [Security, HIGH]; (3) server/security.ts configureSecurity sets X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy but is MISSING Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), and X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors, leaving the app open to clickjacking and reducing XSS defense-in-depth [Security, HIGH].

Document MEDIUM issues: (4) No React error boundary anywhere (grep for ErrorBoundary/componentDidCatch returns none) so any render error blanks the whole SPA [Runtime/UX, MEDIUM]; (5) OTP /api/otp/verify success response omits phoneVerified while /api/auth/login includes it (server/auth.ts around lines 331 vs 457), causing inconsistent client state after OTP login [Type/Logic, MEDIUM]; (6) 7 npm audit vulnerabilities (1 high: nodemailer; moderate: qs/body-parser/express, uuid/gaxios, esbuild dev-server) [Dependency, MEDIUM] - note that esbuild fix is a breaking major bump and should be a recommendation, while nodemailer/qs/uuid fixes are safe via `npm audit fix`; (7) Accessibility: form inputs are not consistently associated with labels (68 <label> elements but only 15 htmlFor attributes across src) and some inputs lack aria-labels [Accessibility, MEDIUM]; (8) index.html hard-codes lang="en" although the app is bilingual and can render Marathi, hurting screen-reader pronunciation [Accessibility, MEDIUM].

Document LOW issues: (9) Vite build emits a >500kB single JS chunk (671kB / 175kB gzip) with no code-splitting or manualChunks configured in vite.config.ts [Performance, LOW]; (10) index.html loads three external font CDNs (Google Fonts x2, jsdelivr) with no local fallback and no CSP allowlist [Performance/Security, LOW]; (11) AiAssistant input has no maxLength on the client though the server caps at 1000 chars, so users can type far past the limit before a silent rejection [UX, LOW].

Add an 'Improvement Ideas' section (not bugs) covering: introduce an automated test suite (currently zero tests) e.g. Vitest + React Testing Library and API integration tests; add a CSP + security headers middleware; code-split the bundle and lazy-load portal routes with React.lazy/Suspense; add a global ErrorBoundary with a friendly bilingual fallback; add loading/empty/error states audit; add pre-commit lint via husky; wire dependabot/npm audit into CI; add alt text and label auditing to CI (e.g. eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y); consider self-hosting fonts; add an offline/PWA manifest since it targets low-connectivity rural users.

For every issue, add a 'Status' note: mark items (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(8),(11) and safe dependency fixes as 'Auto-fixed in FEAT-002/FEAT-003', and mark test-suite, esbuild major bump, code-splitting, and self-hosting fonts as 'Recommended (not auto-applied)'. Keep the report accurate to what the coder actually fixes.
acceptance_criteria: ISSUES_REPORT.md exists at the repository root.
The report contains a severity-categorized list (Critical/High/Medium/Low) where every listed issue has an error-type tag and a concrete file reference.
The report contains a distinct 'Improvement Ideas' section separate from the bug list.
Every issue has a Status note indicating whether it is auto-fixed or a recommendation.
npm run lint still exits 0 (a markdown file must not break the typecheck).
verification: Confirm the file exists and is non-empty.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm it exits 0.
findings: Created ISSUES_REPORT.md (223 lines) at repo root. All findings were verified against the live codebase before writing: agents.ts:99 default 'gemini-3.6-flash' confirmed; Math.random for OTP/PIN confirmed at auth.ts:756/1049/1557 and sms-otp.ts:13; security.ts sets X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy but has no CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options (confirmed ~lines 220-224); no ErrorBoundary/componentDidCatch anywhere in src (grep = 0 matches); phoneVerified present in login payload (auth.ts:457) and OTP verify tracks it locally (auth.ts:305/317/331) - documented the M-2 inconsistency accordingly; index.html:2 has lang="en" and loads 3 external font CDNs (googleapis, gstatic, jsdelivr) at lines 7-18; vite.config.ts has no chunkSizeWarningLimit/manualChunks; a11y label/htmlFor mismatch confirmed (68 <label> vs 15 htmlFor); AiAssistant.tsx has no maxLength while server caps at 1000 (agents.ts:10). Report includes Severity legend, Error-type legend, Critical/High/Medium/Low sections, an Improvement Ideas section, per-issue Status notes, and a status summary table. Note: the primary grep_search tool returned false 'no matches' for several patterns; bash grep confirmed the real lines, so all references were cross-checked via bash. Verification: `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit) exits 0 after adding the markdown file; build not re-run since a markdown file cannot affect it. No source code changed (docs-only feature). Note per orchestrator: the report describes M-4 label a11y as a partial auto-fix + recommendation and M-3 esbuild as recommendation-only; FEAT-002/FEAT-003 should honor those Status notes when applying fixes.
